question.text: What is the BEP for a USDINR call option with strike Rs. 84.00 and premium Rs. 0.30?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook gives the long-call break-even point as Strike + Premium and the long-put break-even point as Strike - Premium. For this call: BEP = 84.00 + 0.30 = Rs. 84.30. The Trap: Rs. 83.70 applies the Strike - Premium formula, which is the put break-even. Rs. 84.00 is just the strike, and Rs. 84.60 doubles the premium. Note: Workbook references — p.81 (long-call BEP = strike + premium) and pp.83-84 (long-put BEP = strike - premium).
